subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the objects.
Sweep the far-right red brick leftward completely inside the dustpan using the brush in the right hand and the pan in the left.
Sweep the remaining blue and white objects on the far side of the table leftward completely into the dustpan with the right-hand brush. Keep the red brick inside.

Lift the right-hand brush straight up clear of the loaded dustpan, set it flat on the table well to the right, and leave the loaded dustpan level on the table. Then fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
